task.title: Implement additive relay v2 publication and atomic claims
task.description: Make the independent relay-v2 RED suite green and expose additive v2 publish/claim HTTP routes while preserving all v1 behavior.
task.scope: apps/relay v2 prekey model, validation, storage, service, handler, and routing

acceptance_criteria: The race-enabled tagged T22 Go suite passes.
Raw-bundle immutability, permanent OTK reservations, concurrent allocation, and exact claim replay are durable in Badger.
Relay validates the fixed root/device binding required by the shared fixture and rejects malformed, expired, or forged bundles.
Additive /v2/prekeys/publish and /v2/prekeys/claim routes have tested deterministic errors and statuses.
Existing v1 Go tests and shared protocol tests remain green.
constraints: Load task-implementer and validate the paired task-implementer input before editing.
Confirm the supplied tagged test is RED, then make it GREEN without weakening or deleting tests.
Use apply_patch for edits and keryx ctx rg for every search.
Do not edit flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md.
Do not modify apps/cli or existing protocol contracts/fixtures except adding a necessary test correction with explicit evidence.
Do not commit because the repository has an unborn untracked baseline.
Add focused handler/router tests for both v2 endpoints and error mappings.
Write and validate a subagent-result at the output artifact path; final response starts STATUS:.
